```{r setup, include=FALSE} 
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	echo = FALSE,
	message = FALSE,
	warning = FALSE
)

#Load packages
library(gdata)
library(flextable)

#Load bootstrap function
setwd("../code/Bootstrap")
source("bootstrap_functions.R")


#function to prepare data for analysis
prep_data <- function (finaldata_primary) {
  
  finaldata_primary <- finaldata_primary %>%
  #exclude trials with no unscreened control arm
  filter(comparator_other_screening=="Not applicable") %>%
  # calculate weights (inverse variance 1/log(v))
  mutate(weight_var = 1/vi_m) %>%
  #only keep trials with available surrogate estimate
  filter(!is.na(yi_s)) %>%
  #count trials in analysis
  mutate(N_trials=n_distinct(trial_acro_sm))
  
  return(finaldata_primary)
}


#Create results table for surrogate 1
results_surrogate_7 <- data.frame(Cancer=character(),
                                  Surrogate=character(),
                                  Analysis=character(),
                                  Ntrials=numeric(),
                                  Intercept=numeric(),
                                  Intercept_lb_ci=numeric(),
                                  Intercept_ub_ci=numeric(),
                                  Slope=numeric(),
                                  Slope_lb_ci=numeric(),
                                  Slope_ub_ci=numeric(),
                                  Correlation=numeric(),
                                  Correlation_lb_ci=numeric(),
                                  Correlation_ub_ci=numeric(),
                                  Rsquared=numeric(),
                                  Rsquared_lb_ci=numeric(),
                                  Rsquared_ub_ci=numeric()
                                  )

#function to print cancer-specific results
print_results <- function(results_surrogate_7, cancer) {
  results_surrogate_7 %>%
    filter(Cancer == cancer) %>%
    mutate(Slope_lb_ci = ifelse(Slope_lb_ci == "-99999", "-Inf", Slope_lb_ci)) %>%
    mutate(Slope_ub_ci = ifelse(Slope_ub_ci == "99999", "Inf", Slope_ub_ci)) %>%
    flextable() %>%
    set_header_labels(
      Ntrials = "N trials",
      Intercept_lb_ci = "Intercept 95% CI; lower",
      Intercept_ub_ci = "Intercept 95% CI; upper",
      Slope_lb_ci = "Slope 95% CI; lower",
      Slope_ub_ci = "Slope 95% CI; upper",
      Correlation_lb_ci = "Correlation 95% CI; lower",
      Correlation_ub_ci = "Correlation 95% CI; upper",
      Rsquared = "R-squared",
      Rsquared_lb_ci = "R-squared 95% CI; lower",
      Rsquared_ub_ci = "R-squared 95% CI; upper"
    ) %>%
    autofit()
}

#function for cancer-specific plots
plot_cancer <- function(finaldata_primary_7, cancer){
    
  plot_cancer <- ggplot(finaldata_primary_7, aes(x = yi_s, y = exp(yi_m), label=trial_acro_sm, weight=weight_var)) +
    stat_smooth(method="lm", colour=NA, fullrange=T)+
    geom_point(aes(size = weight_var), shape = 16, colour="darkslateblue") +
    geom_abline(intercept = results_surrogate_7$Intercept[results_surrogate_7$Cancer==cancer], slope = results_surrogate_7$Slope[results_surrogate_7$Cancer==cancer]) +
    #geom_abline(intercept=0, slope=1, linetype=2)+
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype=3)+
    #geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype=3)+
    labs(x="Diagnostic yield of screening (%)", y="RR Mortality")+
    geom_text(hjust=-0.05, vjust=-0.5)+
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",plot.caption=element_text(hjust=0), aspect.ratio = 1)

  return(plot_cancer)
}


```

# Primary analysis

## Ovarian 

```{r ovarian, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

setwd("../code/Estimates")
source("Ovarian.R")

gdata::keep(
  finaldata_primary_7,
  results_surrogate_7,
  analysis,
  prep_data,
  print_results,
  plot_cancer,
  bootstrap_trial,
  sure = T
)


finaldata_primary_7 <- prep_data(finaldata_primary_7)

#Analysis (see function in Allcancer_functions.R)
results_surrogate_7 <- results_surrogate_7 %>%
  add_row(analysis(finaldata_primary_7, "Ovarian", "7. Diagnostic yield of screening", "Primary", bootstrap_trial))

# print results table for cancer
print_results(results_surrogate_7, "Ovarian")
  
# bubble plot
plot <- plot_cancer(finaldata_primary_7,"Ovarian") 

plot +
  scale_y_continuous(trans="log", limits = c(0.1,6), breaks=c(0.5,1,1.5, 2, 3,5))+
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,0.0075))
  

```

# Additional plots

```{r plots, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Load cancer-specific data
setwd("../code/Estimates")
source("Ovarian.R")
ovarian <- finaldata_primary_7 %>%
  mutate(cancer="Ovarian")

setwd("../code/Estimates")
source("Cervical.R")
cervical <- finaldata_primary_7 %>%
  mutate(cancer="Cervical") %>%
  #differentiate Mumbai Breast and Cervix
  mutate(trial_acro_sm=ifelse(trial_acro_sm=="Mumbai Breast Cervix","Mumbai Cervix",trial_acro_sm))

setwd("../code/Estimates")
source("Occult.R")
occult <- finaldata_primary_7 %>%
  mutate(cancer="Occult")

setwd("../code/Estimates")
source("Liver.R")
liver <- finaldata_primary_7 %>%
  mutate(cancer="Liver")

setwd("../code/Estimates")
source("Nasopharyngeal.R")
nasopharyngeal <- finaldata_primary_7 %>%
  mutate(cancer="Nasopharyngeal")

setwd("../code/Estimates")
source("Oral.R")
oral <- finaldata_primary_7 %>%
  mutate(cancer="Oral")

setwd("../code/Estimates")
source("Lung.R")
lung <- finaldata_primary_7 %>%
  mutate(cancer="Lung")

setwd("../code/Estimates")
source("Prostate.R")
prostate <- finaldata_primary_7 %>%
  mutate(cancer="Prostate")

setwd("../code/Estimates")
source("Breast.R")
breast <- finaldata_primary_7 %>%
  mutate(cancer="Breast") %>%
    #differentiate Mumbai Breast and Cervix
    mutate(trial_acro_sm=ifelse(trial_acro_sm=="Mumbai Breast Cervix","Mumbai Breast",trial_acro_sm))

setwd("../code/Estimates")
source("Bowel.R")
bowel <- finaldata_primary_7 %>%
  mutate(cancer="Bowel")

gdata::keep(
  ovarian,
  cervical,
  liver,
  nasopharyngeal,
  oral,
  occult,
  lung,
  prostate,
  breast,
  bowel,
  results_surrogate_7,
  analysis,
  prep_data,
  min_N_trials,
  bootstrap_trial,
  sure = T
)

all_finaldata_primary_7 <- bind_rows(ovarian,
                                     cervical,
                                     liver,
                                     nasopharyngeal,
                                     oral,
                                     occult,
                                     lung,
                                     prostate,
                                     breast,
                                     bowel)


all_finaldata_primary_7 <- prep_data(all_finaldata_primary_7) 

all_finaldata_primary_7 <- all_finaldata_primary_7 %>%
  # remove cancer with <3 trials available
  filter(cancer!="Liver") %>%
  filter(cancer!="Nasopharyngeal") %>%
  filter(cancer!="Oral") %>%
  filter(cancer!="Cervical")

# Surrogate 7 - by cancer grid
ggplot(all_finaldata_primary_7, aes(x = yi_s, y = exp(yi_m), label=trial_acro_sm, weight=weight_var)) +
  #remove ovarian cancer 95% CIs to reflect results (taking into account common control groups in UKCTOCS)
  stat_smooth(data=subset(all_finaldata_primary_7, cancer!="Ovarian"), method="lm", colour="black", linewidth=0.6, fullrange=T)+
  stat_smooth(data=subset(all_finaldata_primary_7, cancer=="Ovarian"), method="lm", colour="black", linewidth=0.6, fullrange=T, se=F)+
  geom_point(aes(size = weight_var), shape = 16, colour="darkslateblue") +
  #geom_abline(intercept=0, slope=1, linetype=2)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype=3)+
  #geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype=3)+
  labs(x="Diagnostic yield of screening (%)", y="RR Mortality")+
    scale_y_continuous(trans="log", limits = c(0.3,6), breaks=c(0.5,1,2,5)) +
  facet_wrap(~cancer, nrow=2)+
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",plot.caption=element_text(hjust=0), aspect.ratio = 1) 


```
